title: Past Simple
intro: Kata kerja beraturan mendapat -ed di bentuk lampau (watched, studied). Hafalkan enam kata kerja tak beraturan ini: go → went, eat → ate, have → had, see → saw, do → did, write → wrote.

exercises.prompt: Match each verb to its past form
exercises.explanation: Ini kata kerja tak beraturan, jadi tidak mendapat -ed: go → went, eat → ate, have → had, see → saw, do → did, write → wrote.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the past form
exercises.explanation: 'Watch' adalah kata kerja beraturan, jadi tambahkan -ed: watched. 'Yesterday' menunjukkan waktu lampau.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the past form
exercises.explanation: Konsonan + y: ubah y menjadi i, lalu tambahkan -ed: studied.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the past form
exercises.explanation: 'Go' tak beraturan: bentuk lampaunya went, bukan 'goed'.
'Watch' beraturan: tambahkan -ed menjadi watched. Tidak ada -s di bentuk lampau.

exercises.question: Pick the correct past sentence.
exercises.explanation: 'Go' tak beraturan: went. Jangan menambahkan -ed pada bentuk lampau tak beraturan.

exercises.question: Last week she ___ a letter to her grandmother.
exercises.explanation: 'Write' tak beraturan: bentuk lampaunya wrote. 'Last week' menunjukkan waktu lampau.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the past form

exercises.question: I ___ my homework yesterday.
exercises.explanation: 'Do' tak beraturan: bentuk lampaunya did. 'Yesterday' menunjukkan waktu lampau.
